_what_this_is: The stack-specific half of DynaChat's harness. `ci.py` owns the ladder; this file
owns the repo-specific commands and the locked browser regression fixture.
The numerical floors are observed values, not aspirations. Adding checks does not
raise a floor until the validation host has actually measured the new total.
_unit_count_pattern: unit.py requires backend, frontend, and factory trust-boundary suites to run.
Floor is 1033, observed by quick-authority on ubuntu for the tree on main (2026-09-04).
_e2e_timeout_s: The watchdog for the whole e2e rung. The journey now streams the locked question twice,
once from the harness side (E2E_STREAM_PROBE) and once in the browser, each bounded by
browser.response_timeout_s, plus login probes and browser startup (D-051).

_question_template: Rendered by harness/e2e.py with the fixture's `{title}` (and `{description}`) exactly
as GET /api/videos lists them, after the catalog probe and before the stream probe
and the browser; the rendered question is printed as E2E_QUESTION. The earlier
literal question (`Based on the video I just added, ...`) invited the model to answer
that it cannot see uploads and never search, so whether a citation appeared was luck
(run 34020965800 made no tool call, D-062). A `question` key without this one is
still honoured as a literal, for a configuration from before D-062.
browser.question_template: Summarize the main topic of the video titled "{title}" and cite the source.
_credentials: DARK_FACTORY_E2E_EMAIL and DARK_FACTORY_E2E_PASSWORD live only in the external
validation environment. Signup is rate-limited, so the gate uses a dedicated
seeded validation account instead of manufacturing a new user on every run.
